Snapshot sequences

Source: R/temporal-graph.R
snapshot_sequence.Rd

snapshot_sequence() wraps an ordered list of graphs on the same nodes. temporal_snapshots() builds one from events: snapshot k contains the events with breaks[k] <= t < breaks[k + 1] (the last interval is closed on the right), or with cumulative = TRUE all events with t < breaks[k + 1]. Repeated interactions become edge weights (counts).

Usage

snapshot_sequence(
  graphs,
  start = seq_along(graphs) - 1,
  end = seq_along(graphs)
)

temporal_snapshots(tg, breaks = 10L, cumulative = FALSE)

Arguments

graphs

List of graph_data objects with equal num_nodes.

start, end

Interval bounds per snapshot.

tg

A temporal_graph_data object.

breaks

Number of equal width intervals, or a sorted vector of cut points.

cumulative

Accumulate all earlier events into each snapshot.

Value

An object of class snapshot_sequence.
